svg.text: Multi-Thread SLAM / VIO Architectural Execution Comparison
Comparing MSCKF Filter vs Factor Graph vs ORB-SLAM3 Baseline vs Hybrid KLT vs GPU cuVSLAM
1. OpenVINS Thread Architecture -- Single Primary MSCKF Thread (CPU)
Sequential single-threaded execution per frame (Total ~20.6 ms)
2. Kimera-VIO Thread Architecture -- 2 Concurrent Threads (Frontend + Backend, CPU)
Continuous lightweight frontend (8.9 ms) + Asynchronous iSAM2 keyframe optimization (18.5 ms)
3. ORB-SLAM3 Original Baseline -- 3 Concurrent Threads (High CPU Contention)
Heavy ORB extraction every frame (54.6 ms) + Local BA mutex lock contention (65.0 ms)
4. ORB-SLAM3 Hybrid KLT Tracking (Ours) -- 3 Concurrent Threads (Optimized CPU)
Lightweight KLT on non-KFs (19-25 ms) + Selective ORB on KFs + 40% reduced keyframe load
5. NVIDIA cuVSLAM Thread Architecture -- 3 GPU-Accelerated Pipelines (CUDA Cores)
Real-Time GPU Frontend (5.8 ms / >170 FPS) + Asynchronous Local BA (9.5 ms) + GPU Loop PGO (12.0 ms)
